name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 23, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Dr. Sunny Cooke, Superintendent/President of MiraCosta College
4B.
Update on the Cyclovia Event
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the September 18, 2019 Regular Meeting, September 25, 2019 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and September 25, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-10-23 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-10-23 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the January 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt City Council Resolution 2019-88 approving changes to the January 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule.
2019-10-23 Item 08C January 2020 Council Meeting Schedule
8D.
Adoption of Ordinance 2019-20 Adding Chapter 9.31 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Safe Storage of Firearms. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance 2019-20 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Chapter 9.31 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Safe Storage of Firearms.”
2019-10-23 Item 08D Safe Storage of Firearms Ordinance 2019-20
8E.
Amend contract with Energy Policy Initiatives Center and adjust budget for Climate Action Plan Update. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney to amend the contract for services with the Energy Policy Initiatives Center (EPIC), in substantial form as attached, to update the Climate Action Plan (CAP) to incorporate the results from the completed Housing Element and Active Transportation Plan, for a cost of $83,200, plus 5% contingency not to exceed a total of $87,360; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2019-84, titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.”
2019-10-23 Item 08E Climate Action Plan Update Budget Amendment
8F.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-19 Establishing New Speed Limits on portions of Vulcan Avenue, San Elijo Avenue, and Santa Fe Drive. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt Ordinance No. 2019-19, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on Portions of Vulcan Avenue, San Elijo Avenue, and Santa Fe Drive.”
2019-10-23 Item 08F Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-19
8G.
Mobility Projects and Grants Update – Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Receive the report on the status of Mobility projects and grants.
2019-10-23 Item 08G Mobility Projects and Grants Update
8H.
Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Improvements Project (CS19B). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
Approve the plans, specifications, and authorize advertisement of the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Improvements Project (CS19B).
2019-10-23 Item 08H Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Improvements Project (CS19B)
8I.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-13, which proposes changes of zoning classifications with an associated boundary adjustment, for the Valley parcel from Rural Residential 2 (RR-2) to Rural Residential 1 (RR-1) and Rural Residential (RRFP), and for a portion of the Kratzer parcel from Rural Residential (RRFP) to Rural Residential 1 (RR-1) for portions of the subject parcels. The proposed ordinance will amend the City’s Zoning Map. CASE NO.: 18-047 ZA/GPA/LCPA/BA; LOCATION: 2423 5th Street (Valley) & 2425 5th Street (Kratzer). Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-13 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to the zoning map of the City of Encinitas to reflect changes made with the approval of Case No. 18-047 GPA/ZA/LCP/BA.”
2019-10-23 Item 08I 5th Street GPA Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-13
8J.
Public Hearing and introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-23 to adopt the modification suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2019-01, which amended the Zoning Code and Local Coastal Program to allow Emergency Shelters as a permitted Use in the Business Park and Light Industrial Zones. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-23 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the Modification Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2019-01, Amending Section 30.36.020(B) of Chapter 30.36 Emergency Shelters.”
2019-10-23 Item 08J Emergency Shelter CCC Modification Ordinance 2019-23
8K.
Pedestrian Scramble Crossings on South Coast Highway 101 at the Intersections of D Street, E Street and F Street. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Direct staff to implement pedestrian scramble crossings 7 days a week and 24 hours a day on S. Coast Highway 101 at the intersections of D Street and E Street as phase 1; 2) Direct staff to evaluate the scramble crossings at D Street and E Street and return to Council in 6 months with an update to potentially add a third scramble crossing at F Street; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-79, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.”
2019-10-23 Item 08K South Coast Highway 101 Pedestrian Scramble
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
To initiate the development and solicitation of a Request for Proposals for a Homeless Action Plan and amend the FY 2019-20 Adopted Budget to appropriate $75,000 to fund development of the Plan. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Direct staff to develop a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Homeless Action Plan; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2019-83 amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Adopted Budget and authorizing an appropriation of $75,000 to fund a consultant to develop the Homeless Action Plan.
2019-10-23 Item 10A Homeless Action Plan RFP
10B.
Participation in Homeless Outreach Pilot Program with Community Resource Center. Contact Person: Development Services Director Wisneski
Provide one full-time sheriff’s deputy to participate in the Homeless Outreach Pilot Program, in partnership with the Community Resource Center.
2019-10-23 Item 10B Homeless Outreach Pilot Program
10C.
Introduction of City Council Ordinances No. 2019-14, No. 2019-15, and No. 2019-16 for amendments to Title 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan to accommodate Supportive Housing, Transitional Housing, and Qualified Employee Housing (Ordinance No. 2019-14), include Reasonable Accommodation procedures (Ordinance No. 2019-15), and allow Single Room Occupancy Housing (Ordinance No. 2019-16) in compliance with state law requirements. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-14 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan, to Accommodate Qualified Employee Housing, Supportive Housing, and Transitional Housing in Compliance with State Law;" and 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-15 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, and Local Coastal Plan, to Include Reasonable Accommodation Procedures to Comply with Fair Housing Laws;" and 3) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-16 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and Local Coastal Plan, to Allow Single Room Occupancy Housing as a Permitted Use Where Multi-Family Residential Uses Are Permitted."
2019-10-23 Item 10C Supportive Transitional & Employee Housing Ordinances
10D.
Public Hearing to review and consider the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-21 and Ordinance No. 2019-22. Ordinance No. 2019-21 adopts the 2019 California Building Standards Code, as required by law, which will take effect January 1, 2020. Ordinance No. 2019-22 proposes Municipal Code amendments to implement the Encinitas Climate Action Plan’s strategy related to electric vehicle charging. CASE NOS: PLCY-003360-2019 and APLAN-000015-2018 ZA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Principal Planner Smith
1) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-21, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California adopting Amendments to Chapter 23.12 (Uniform Codes for Construction) of Title 23 (Building and Construction) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to adopt the 2019 California Building Standards Code with certain amendments, additions, and deletions;” and 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-22, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting Amendments to Chapter 23.12 (Uniform Codes for Construction) of Title 23 (Building and Construction) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to implement the City of Encinitas Climate Action Plan’s strategy related to electric vehicle charging.”
2019-10-23 Item 10D Building Code and EV Charging Amendments
10E.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-27, an ordinance of the City of Encinitas which adopts the 2018 International Fire Code and the 2019 California Fire Code with certain amendments, additions, and deletions. Contact Person: Sr. Deputy Fire Marshal Berberet
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-27, titled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Which Repeals Chapter 10.04 of the City of Encinitas Municipal Code and Adopts New Chapter 10.04 Adopting the 2018 International Fire Code and 2019 California Fire Code with certain amendments, additions, and deletions.
2019-10-23 Item 10E Fire Code Update
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Information report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 30, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
